blurb: Savannah Cruise Company offers flexible, thoughtfully organized boat cruises that feel like spending the day on the water with a local friend. Experiences include private party charters, bachelorette parties, dolphin eco tours, shark-tooth hunting, fishing charters, and sunset cruises. Guests can bring their own food and drinks, and cruises typically last 2-4 hours with a 2 hour minimum.
